card.text: Saturn-mass planet that circles both stars of Kepler-16, one year every 226 days.

introduction.text: Kepler-16 (AB) b circles two stars at once, a real Tatooine. It is three-quarters as wide as Jupiter and a third as heavy; here it is a plain gray sphere.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A gray sphere of the measured radius, lit by star A. No colour, surface or atmosphere is observed.
